question: What is the meaning of duration material is expected to last under normal conditions in relation to expected lifetime?
data_point: duration material is expected to last under normal conditions
description: The duration material is expected to last under normal conditions refers to the estimated lifespan of a product, which is a measure of how long the product is anticipated to function before it requires maintenance, replacement, or upgrades. This estimated lifespan is compared to the average life span of the building layer the product is applied in, as indicated by the CIUse indicator. The expected lifetime, on the other hand, is the potential functional lifespan of a product in years, as represented by the L variable in the CIUse formula. Both terms are related to the longevity and performance of a product over time.
